name: scryfall-mcp-server
description: Community MCP server to search and fetch Magic: The Gathering card data from Scryfall with a rich card viewer UI. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Scryfall.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search for Magic: The Gathering cards using Scryfall query syntax

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch detailed card information by Scryfall UUID

tools.name: get_rule
tools.description: Look up the Comprehensive Rules by rule number, with citations

tools.name: search_rules
tools.description: Search the Comprehensive Rules and glossary, with citations

tools.name: get_rulings
tools.description: Get a card's Oracle text and rulings, with citations
